stage_definitions.PRE_ADMISSIBILITY: Evaluable before delta_a, completed RefOrient_x, [Asym]_x, and <S>_x.
stage_definitions.DELTA_A_DEPENDENT: Requires delta_a evaluation, realized continuation, or a downstream witness produced after reference construction.
stage_definitions.COMPOSITION_LAW: Governs chains, associativity, or composition algebra rather than a binary observation-assignment compatibility relation.
stage_definitions.UNRESOLVED: Source dependency or typing is insufficiently explicit for classification.

guard_inventory.source_guard: Type(X), Type(Z), and Context(Y) are declared.
guard_inventory.required_bridge: Map source operand and context types to observation-orientation carriers and B_x, D_rel, R.

guard_inventory.dependency: Declared distinction values and epsilon floor.
guard_inventory.required_bridge: Show the distinction-floor test is over the candidate pair and does not require completed RefOrient or bounded realization.

guard_inventory.required_action: Keep outside BCon_x and PermittedResolution_x pre-guard projection.

guard_inventory.source_guard: Result remains in RT union aRT union typed_closure_candidate.
guard_inventory.dependency: Result typing and possible closure-candidate construction.
guard_inventory.required_bridge: Determine whether result typing is checked on source operands or only after downstream realization.

guard_inventory.dependency: Chains of more than one composition.
guard_inventory.required_action: Do not project into PairwiseCompatible_x without a separate typing argument.

guard_inventory.dependency: May be prebound source class or may depend on completed closure support.
guard_inventory.required_bridge: Show closure-class data is available before RefOrient and ProjectBounded.

guard_inventory.source_guard: Failure on missing or invalid operand typing, undefined context, distinction collapse, empty admissibility, closure incompatibility, or ordering collapse.
guard_inventory.dependency: Individual failure branches have different dependency stages.
guard_inventory.required_action: Retain only individually proven pre-admissibility branches; do not project the aggregate failure set wholesale.
